listen_addr.description: IP address on which lbcd listens for incoming load reports.

listen_port.description: UDP port to receive load reports from backend nodes.

report_interval.description: How often (in seconds) backend nodes should send load reports.

report_max_age.description: Maximum age (in seconds) of a received load report before it is discarded.

cache_ttl.description: Time-to-live (in seconds) for cached load entries.

allowed_subnets.description: List of allowed IP subnets (CIDR notation) permitted to send load reports.

strict_mode.description: If true, only accept load reports from IPs in `allowed_subnets`.

log_debug.description: Enable verbose debug logging to stderr or syslog.

pidfile.description: Path to write the daemon’s PID file.

status_file.description: Path to write the current load status in JSON for external tools.

max_reporters.description: Maximum number of concurrent reporter nodes allowed.

class_weights.description: Weight configuration for computing overall system load score from metric classes.

class.description: Name of the metric class (e.g., cpu, mem, net).

weight.description: Relative weight (0.0–1.0) for this class in the aggregated load score.

backends.description: List of backend services that receive traffic based on load decisions.

host.description: IP address or hostname of the backend.

port.description: Port number of the backend service.

protocol.description: Protocol used to connect to this backend.

weight.description: Traffic weight relative to other backends (higher = more traffic).

enabled.description: If false, backend is excluded from load balancing decisions.

health_check.description: Settings for proactive health checks of backends.

enabled.description: Enable automatic health checks for backends.

max_failures.description: Failures before backend is marked unhealthy.

alerts.description: List of alert endpoints to notify on backend status changes (e.g., down/up).
